package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	cfg "github.com/system-inc/cohere/internal/lint/ecmascript/control_flow_graph"
	"os"
	"unicode/utf16"
)

func main() {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	var inputs []string
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &inputs); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	for _, input := range inputs {
		for _, unit := range utf16.Encode([]rune(cfg.AdamicNormalizeBigIntLiteral(input))) {
			fmt.Printf("%d,", unit)
		}
		fmt.Println()
	}
}
